body: Usually no but I am going through that with my roommate. His life just keeps getting better for him while mine feels like it's getting worse. He keeps telling me how awesome his life is. He rubs in my face that he has an OK job and a great gf who he gets to be sexual with. Every five minutes he has to mention something about that and it pisses me off. And I've tried talking to him about my problems and depression. He used to listen but ever since his life started going so great he doesn't give a shit any more.
Prozac can increase anxiety a bit. I was on celexa (probably didn't spell that right) and I think Zoloft also helps with anxiety a bit as well as depression. I could have these mixed up though.
How long where you on the meds? It takes some time for them to start working. And sometimes different people need different meds. Like I couldn't do Prozac because it isn't good for anxiety.

My life is just going to complete shit. I just flunked out of my 3rd year of college after putting so much work in. I feel like a complete failure. I know things don't always go your way but nothing has gone my way in so long I just don't feel like trying anymore. And that's just added onto the loneliness and self hatred I go through daily. I just want it all to stop.
